questions.prompt: What did young Franklin buy when he first arrived in Philadelphia?
questions.rationale: "He gave me accordingly three great Puffy Rolls . . . walk'd off with a Roll under each Arm."

questions.prompt: What did Franklin call the club he formed for mutual improvement?
questions.rationale: "I had form'd most of my ingenious Acquaintance into a Club for mutual Improvement, which we called the Junto."

questions.prompt: In one sentence, what was Franklin's 'Project' described in his most famous self-improvement passage?
questions.model_answer: His attempt to achieve moral perfection by systematically practicing thirteen named virtues.
questions.rationale: "It was about this time I conceiv'd the bold and arduous Project of arriving at moral Perfection."

questions.prompt: What honor did Franklin's electrical experiments earn him?
choices: Election to the Royal Society and the Copley Medal
questions.rationale: "[The discoveries] gain'd me the Honour of being chosen a Member of the Royal Society . . . a handsome Gold Medal was voted to me."

questions.prompt: According to Poor Richard's Almanack, what does rising early make a person?
questions.rationale: "Early to Bed, and early to rise, makes a Man healthy, wealthy, and wise."
